answer: Splitting into 6 separate vaults requires a separate funded garden account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The nectar explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the plume binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Bonded capital sits idle for 19 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
